busyDetail: Keep the window open to follow progress, or close automatically when the work finishes.
failedMessage: An operation did not finish successfully.
failedDetail: Observanda remains open. Open Activity to review the result.
unavailableMessage: Observanda could not check whether its work has finished.
unavailableDetail: The window remains open. Try closing it again when the service responds.
shutdownMessage: The service has not yet confirmed shutdown.
shutdownDetail: Observanda is waiting for its service to finish safely.
http-drain: The service is finishing requests and background work.
database-stop: The databases are finishing their shutdown.
shutdownUnresponsive: The service is not responding to status requests. Its current outcome is uncertain.
shutdownRecovery: Keep waiting while storage is active. If the service remains unresponsive and a system restart is necessary, reopen the same workspace afterwards and review unfinished operations before retrying. Do not delete database files or lock files to force it open.
externalMessage: Open this link in your browser?
unsavedMessage: Leave this window with unsaved work?
unsavedDetail: Return to Observanda to save your changes first.
aboutDetail: Your workspace is stored separately from the application. Closing Observanda stops its local service.
startFailedDetail: Your saved work has not been removed. Close this window and try again.
serviceStartFailed: The bundled application service could not start. Reinstall or repair Observanda.
serviceStopped: The local service stopped unexpectedly. Saved changes remain in your workspace.
windowFailed: The desktop window could not initialize. Your saved work has not been changed.
